role: Read-only runtime verifier; all subsequent runs used same-hash executable copies under this private output tree.
lease: B granted exclusive GPU/audio qualification lease; released after v4-toggle-shroud. No A runtime process remains.

dust_water_cleanup.limit: Fine land streaks are primarily a motion cue; individual low cards are not reliably identifiable in a still.

takeover_harness_visibility.terrain_light: Both actual TOD2 and identical ambient/diffuse. Darkness is fog attenuation, not night.

flat_modern_pond_ripples.limit: Clear visible circles; final v4 changed only sand low-alpha and tree-period behavior, but this specific flat-pond capture was v3.

sloped_river_normal.limit: Ring pixel alignment is UNOBSERVABLE on this noisy river surface. Do not count normals/counters as visual proof.

option_and_script_lifecycle.behavior: Option off and script hide zero envelope/intensity/audio/wind; on/show reentry starts with an eased fade and reaches wet again.

shroud_admission.limit: No clear surface impacts discernible in the fogged region; atmospheric falling rain can still appear above it.

night_cycle.limit: True night fixture is very dark. Final v4 day/night matrix remains B-owned.

known_limitations: Water contacts follow authored rest-surface pond/river planes and triangle normals, not dynamic modern-wave displacement.
Sloped-river ring pixels were not reliably isolated; this remains visually unaccepted.
Rain timing is current draw floor((logic_frame-1)*1000/60)/1000, not the earlier takeScreenShot entry value.
No timed benchmark ran under GDB; all A runs were qualification only.
harness_failures: v4-sand-day: GDB referenced TheGlobalData macro rather than TheWritableGlobalData symbol; run aborted before images.
v4-sand-day-visible: GDB referenced m_shroudOn, which is absent in Release; run aborted after raw video capture. Both failed outputs are preserved.
scope_note: First sand-shore-close launch used the frozen v3 executable path directly, so the engine may have refreshed adjacent runtime logs/Ping/StateChanged. All later launches used private same-hash copies; source, tests, docs, binary and overlay contents were not edited by A during verifier role.
